== Original printed-face citation; transcription review held ==
Added the [https://web.archive.org/web/20080517034457/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/hyperwavescan.html archived original Decipher card page] as an explicitly labeled printed-face source, retaining separate rules and errata evidence. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20041113031001im_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/hyperwavescan.gif original black-border scan] was visually checked. In game text, the original says ‘Scanning Crew is now immune to Sense.’ while the current article says ‘Scanning Crew is immune to Sense.’ The original also says “with ‘Rebel’ in card name found there.” while the current article says “with 'Rebel' in the title found there.” These differences are recorded for review only. No card data, game text, lore, stats, icons, UID, version label, ruling prose or sibling page was changed, and the citation addition does not certify the current transcription as identical to the printed face.
